scenes.heading: Growing a creator's account without overpromising results

sents.d: Growing a creator's account without overpromising results
Sustainable growth tactics protect the relationship better than aggressive short-term pushes.

Consistent, moderate growth from sustainable tactics (content quality, posting consistency, genuine engagement) tends to hold up better over time than aggressive short-term growth tactics that risk platform penalties or subscriber churn once the tactic stops.

Setting realistic growth expectations with a creator upfront, rather than promising specific numbers you can't fully control, protects the relationship when growth is slower than hoped in any given month.
Regularly reviewing what's actually driving subscriber growth or churn (not just the numbers themselves) helps you make real adjustments instead of guessing at what to change next.

take: Grow steadily and never promise numbers you can't control.
